title: DARC DOKs and special DOKs
document_title: DOK-Liste (DARC DX-Referat, by DL2ABM) and the special-DOK list SDOK_List.csv (DARC SDOK-Referat)
authority: DARC issues DOKs (Distrikts-Ortsverbands-Kenner) to its local clubs and special DOKs for events; they are used for DARC's DLD award, the DOK best-lists and the WAG contest. ADIF: 'DARC provides two different lists - one for DOKs and one for Special DOKs.'
terms: DARC states no reuse terms for either list. Shipped unchanged and credited to DARC; this package's licence does not cover them.
derived_note: derived/by_district.json (ours): DARC district -> DOKs, built from the facts. Special-DOK dates are DARC's dd.mm.yy, read as 19yy for yy >= 50 and 20yy below.
